newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times page one stories.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times page one stories.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page Friday:
- Pope John Paul II has placed the authority of the Roman Catholic Church behind the view that the human body might have been created by evolution rather than by God.
- Independent candidate Ross Perot dismissed a suggestion by Republican candidate Bob Dole to withdraw his bid for the U.S. presidency and give him his support.
- Dole's election campaign appears to be besieged and disordered as election day approaches.
- U.S. podiatrists are forming their first labor union for doctors in reaction to the changes brought by managed care.
